sections.title: Game
lines: Created by the Idle Pioneer team

sections.title: Music
lines: Original arrangements of public-domain tunes, made for this game:
Yankee Doodle, Soldier's Joy, Greensleeves, Drunken Sailor (traditional)
Minuet in G, BWV Anh. 114 (Christian Petzold, 1725)
Rendered with the GeneralUser GS SoundFont by S. Christian Collins

sections.title: Sound Effects
lines: Sound effects and ambience generated with ElevenLabs

sections.title: Fonts

Almendra by Ana Sanfelippo, SIL Open Font License 1.1

sections.title: Historical Note
lines: The figures and artifacts in this game are real people and objects from colonial history.
All portraits and depictions are original artwork made for the game, not likenesses taken from any collection.
